segments.text: As Jesus left the temple and was walking away, His disciples came up to Him to point out its buildings.
Do you see all these things?
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: He replied.
Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to Him privately.
Tell us,
segments.speaker: Disciples

segments.text: they said,
when will these things happen, and what will be the sign of Your coming and of the end of the age?
segments.speaker: The disciples

segments.text: Jesus answered, “See to it that no one deceives you.
For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will deceive many.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. These things must happen, but the end is still to come.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: At that time many will fall away and will betray and hate one another,
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: and many false prophets will arise and mislead many.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Because of the multiplication of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ described by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve anything from his house.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
For at that time there will be great tribulation, unmatched from the beginning of the world until now, and never to be seen again.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: At that time, if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: See, I have told you in advance.
segments.speaker: Jesus

text: The Return of the Son of Man

segments.text: So if they tell you, ‘There He is in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here He is in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: For just as the lightning comes from the east and flashes as far as the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text:
Immediately after the tribulation of those days:
‘The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.’
segments.speaker: Jesus

footnotes.text: + Or and the celestial bodies will be shaken; see Isaiah 13:10, Isaiah 34:4, and Joel 2:10.

segments.text: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.

footnotes.text: + Or the sky; twice in this verse

segments.text: And He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
segments.speaker: Jesus

text: The Lesson of the Fig Tree

segments.text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
segments.speaker: Jesus

footnotes.text: + BYZ and TR do not include nor the Son.

segments.text: As it was in the days of Noah, so will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: And they were oblivious, until the flood came and swept them all away. So will it be at the coming of the Son of Man.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Two men will be in the field: one will be taken and the other left.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and the other left.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
segments.speaker: Jesus

segments.text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
segments.speaker: Jesus
